test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a265c8e6566fe59165eead267b92e54ed0c543dc5335ccac4bdc96784bff95.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol 'Square' has shifting two place in anticlockwise direction in next images, and getting Shaded in alternate image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40d023b24b8ca48effd9133701bc2611e848584c0505f67560fc47729edf6914.png] 

Step II: Symbol 'Triangle' has shifting two place in aniticlockwise direction in next images, and getting Shaded in alternate image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8adc1fc3615135ad00931afe1b87ccea8972f49575cd2600850721ea86fb03f.png] 

Step III: Symbol 'Circle' has subtracting one part in each next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/937e72cf625d983846bafe7341b35ac61e8b5b140f7c16bfdbe85dc2259dbd79.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2df88d44509441e2955ed898aad574e3280e2d7e214f35e28aea0e197ed8b5d.png] 

So, 'Option 3' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__****Both Option 1 and 3 has the different image, please check the shaded square carefully.**
